A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed the first CNN-based approach to the problem of body shape reconstruction, which is able to produce results of comparable quality to state of the art, while being orders of magnitude faster.
our approach is able to estimate the shape of people from silhouettes with high accuracy in a fast and robust manner.
we propose an accurate and efficient CNN based method for human body shape estimation, which is robust and can be trained on synthetic data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CNNs can be successfully used to solve challenging shape estimation problems.
, with the right representation of shape and the use of CNNs, it is possible to estimate human body shape from a single silhouette, with a high accuracy, at a very low computational cost.
CNNs can be used to tackle challenging shape estimation problems, even when the input is a binary silhouette, without the need for any prior knowledge about the shape.
